versioning.release_scope: Execute the v2 interface migration while preserving the stable Tkinter application; Stage 0 freezes v1.9.1 contracts, Stage 1 delivers the isolated FastAPI/React/WebView2 onedir prototype, Stage 2 has a tested simulator SMU/spectrometer WebSocket PoC, Stage 3 delivers shared design tokens/components, and Stage 4 adds the compatible working series APIs and workspace, including white LEDs, a fixed 2 1 / 3 4 quarter layout, selectable top/bottom or left/right halves, shared prefixes and spectral calibrations for quarter/half/whole-substrate scopes, and report grouping by quarter or configured scope, while real hardware validation remains pending. Stage 5 begins with a single simulator IVL cycle, validated parameters, backend snapshots, safe shutdown and isolated CSV/XLSX; series measurement parity remains pending.

mutable_prerelease.policy: Move this tag and update the same GitHub prerelease for every migration checkpoint until the user explicitly closes or renames the alpha.

versioning.publication_execution: Run gh authentication checks, branch/tag pushes, and GitHub Release create/edit outside the restricted Codex sandbox with access to the system keyring.

measurement_workflows.IVL: Voltage/current/light sweep and pixel status classification. WORKING and opening voltage use independent photodiode-current thresholds and configurable counts of following above-threshold points, so isolated spikes are ignored. Series mode can skip pixels whose journal status is NONWORKING or BURNED and rebuilds the remaining queue after an arbitrary pixel selection. The modular workflow writes raw CSV during measurement and builds final XLSX after processing. BURNED is final only when the confirmation outcome is nonworking. One latest thumbnail per pixel is stored with every series thumbnail under <series>/thumbnails and uses a shared linear current scale with live-graph colors. Missing, legacy or older-than-workbook renders are refreshed by the Refresh button and on hover in background workers so OneDrive hydration cannot block the Tk UI; missing legacy spectrum metrics are also loaded in the background.
measurement_workflows.SPECTRUM: Spectral measurement with pixel/substrate/explicit-priority-queue selection, chosen queue start, queued-only sequential completion, live integration-time previews, electrical checks before and after every T_int trial, same-pixel NO_CONTACT retry, and burnout-threshold CURRENT_LIMIT diagnostics that may be journaled before same-quarter replacement; CIE/BPW34 recalculation runs separately, selects one spectrum for each configured quarter/half/substrate scope, stores integral_calibration.json plus SPECTRAL_RECALC_*.xlsx under the matching <series>/calibration scope folder without modifying the source workbook, and clamps a linear coefficient below opening voltage to its opening-voltage value.
measurement_workflows.STABILITY: Mutable constant-current feedback or immediate constant-voltage stability measurement; raw CSV and final XLSX retain target and applied values.
